forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: A continue sends the source row again on externalSessionChanges, with the new copy
+---
+Source: Testudo ^bq170kn, brief .briefs/FoundationModelsACPAgent-copy-changes-source-row-2026-11-23.md.
+
+After `copySession(of:folder:name:)` adds a copy to `ExternalSessionContinuations`, no subscriber of `externalSessionChanges(folder:)` gets the source row. So an open read-only tab does not show the new "Continued <date>" until it opens again.
+
+## Fix
+- [ ] The index publishes the row of one read session again, with no read (`ExternalSessionIndex.republish(matching:of:)`). The folder filter of the index and the decoration of the host relay apply as for each change.
+- [ ] `copySession` calls it after `continuations.add`.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] A subscriber of the folder of the source, and a subscriber of each folder, get the source row with the new copy after a continue. #bug
\ No newline at end of file
